subject.title: fix: keep the global loop breaker reachable after tool blocks

question: Should this typed-outcome implementation or the sentinel-based implementation in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/109619 become the canonical fix for the linked issue?
rationale: Both open PRs are proof-positive and target the same current-main defect, but they encode the invariant differently and should not both land.

options.title: Choose typed outcomes
options.body: Rebase and land this PR because it keeps loop vetoes distinct from result hashes and explicitly tests recovery after later progress.

options.title: Choose the sentinel implementation
options.body: Land https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/109619 instead if maintainers prefer its smaller representation, then close this PR as superseded.

recommendation.title: Choose typed outcomes
recommendation.body: Rebase and land this PR because it keeps loop vetoes distinct from result hashes and explicitly tests recovery after later progress.

likelyOwner.reason: Their merged work introduced the adjacent sticky-veto invariant and tests, making them the strongest history-based reviewer for the representation choice.
